versions.content: Provide the ability to handle event specific enable conditions Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support enable conditions per event. If an event specific enable condition is not fulfilled, the reported event status is not processed. Rationale: Support mechanisms to avoid large amounts of event memory entries in case of specific ECU conditions. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: In certain vehicle conditions, such as engine cranking, it shall be avoided to evaluate the result of a monitoring application for a certain time.
